title: Manga 'Hiiragi-san Chi no Kyuuketsu Jijou' Gets TV Anime
content: An official website opened for a television anime adaptation of Miki Yoshikawa 's Hiiragi-san Chi no Kyuuketsu Jijou ( Hiragi-san's House of Vampires ) manga on Saturday, revealing the staff and a teaser visual (pictured). Unlimited Produce by TMS is handling the planning and production.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Fairy Tail
content: Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest finished airing in January 2025, and before that fans of the series hadn’t had anything before the main anime finished airing in 2019. Fairy Tail has always been on the lower rung of the shonen popularity ladder.

title: Anime Market Grew 15.8% to Record 4.45 Trillion Yen in 2025
content: That included 1.91 trillion yen (about US$12.1 billion) growth in the domestic market and 2.54 trillion yen (about US$16.1 billion) growth in the overseas market. The overall global anime market grew by 15.8% last year. The domestic market grew by 14.1% while the overseas market grew by 17.2%.
author: ANN

title: tri-Ace's Resonance of Fate / End of Eternity Game Gets Enhanced Remaster for PS5, Steam Available Now
content: tri-Ace describes the story: In the distant future, humanity faces extinction on a devastated Earth. In an effort to restore the environment, people built a colossal machine called Basel and entrusted it with the cycle of life and death. Zephyr, Vashyron, and Leanne make their living as mercenaries.
author: ANN

title: 'Pole Princess!!' Gets Theatrical Anime in January 2027
content: The official website for the Pole Princess!! anime series announced a new theatrical anime titled Pole Princess!! -Croix du Nord- on Friday, revealing the returning cast and staff. The approximately 60-minute anime will feature five new songs from the Shining Pole Song Album and an original story.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Virtua Fighter Crossroads Game Reveals Character Lionel Rafale in Trailer
content: Sega revealed a new trailer on Thursday for its Virtua Fighter Crossroads game that reveals the new character Lionel Rafale. Sega describes the character: "Les jeux sont faits, rien ne va plus." A mysterious young martial artist named Lionel Rafale has arrived in the city of Vilasapara.
author: ANN

title: Light Novel 'Mushoku Tensei: Dasoku-hen' Concludes with Fourth Volume
content: The official X account for Kadokawa's MF Books label announced on Friday that Rifujin na Magonote 's Mushoku Tensei: Dasoku-hen ( Mushoku Tensei: Redundant Reincarnation ) light novel will end with its fourth volume on November 25.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Pole Princess!! Franchise Gets New CG Theatrical Anime Opening on January 29
content: The official website for Avex Pictures and Tatsunoko Production 's original Pole Princess!! pole dancing anime project revealed on Friday a new theatrical CG anime will screen in six theaters in Japan for two weeks starting on January 29. The new anime is titled Pole Princess!! : Croix du Nord .
author: ANN
